2609.05880.title: Grounded and Faithful P&ID Reasoning: Constraining Vision-Language Models with Recovered Evidence Graphs
2609.05880.paper_summary: Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) are the authoritative maps of process plants: isolation, maintenance, and HAZOP decisions depend on what connects to what. Vision-language models describe these sheets fluently, yet they often invent or miss process connections---and an invented or missed link can reverse an isolation or reachability call, so a plant decision cannot trust a fluent answer that was never checked against the linework. We instead recover an explicit graph of the drawing---its symbols, the process connections between them, and the tags that name them---and then require the model to answer only by querying that graph through seven read-only operators, so a topology claim is returned only when it cites the query results that support it. On TopoPID-VQA, a new suite of 3000 topology questions over these sheets, Graph-Grounded Harness (Ours) raises exact match accuracy from 36.7--41.3% under image-only prompting to 74.3--76.0% for Qwen3-VL-4B, Qwen3-VL-8B, and Gemma-4-E4B. It does so on an imperfect substrate: on Digitize-PID dataset the recovered graph scores F1 0.742 on exact process connections, and 0.801 once symbols and tags are pooled in. The residual errors track that gap---grounding pays off where the recovered graph is right, and perception error still breaks topology questions where it is not.
2609.05880.paper_summary_zh: 管道與儀表圖（P&ID）是過程工廠的權威地圖：隔離、維護和危險性評估（HAZOP）決策依賴於什麼連接到什麼。視覺語言模型流利地描述這些圖紙，但它們經常發明或遺漏過程連接——而一個發明或遺漏的連結可能會顛倒隔離或可達性判斷，因此工廠的決策無法信任一個從未與線路檢查過的流利答案。我們則恢復圖紙的顯式圖形——其符號、它們之間的過程連接，以及命名它們的標籤——然後要求模型僅通過七個只讀操作符查詢該圖形來回答問題，因此只有在引用支持它的查詢結果時，拓撲聲明才會返回。在TopoPID-VQA上，這是一套針對這些圖紙的3000個拓撲問題，Graph-Grounded Harness（我們的）將精確匹配準確率從36.7-41.3%（在僅圖像提示下）提高到74.3-76.0%（對於Qwen3-VL-4B、Qwen3-VL-8B和Gemma-4-E4B）。這是在一個不完美的基礎上進行的：在Digitize-PID數據集上，恢復的圖形在精確過程連接上得分F1 0.742，並且在符號和標籤合併後得分0.801。殘餘錯誤追踪著這個差距——當恢復的圖形正確時，基礎是有回報的，而感知錯誤仍然在不正確的地方破壞拓撲問題。
